description: This file defines a data structure and parsing logic for configuring a 'Talk Mode Gateway' in an application, including state representation (`TalkModeGatewayConfigState`) and a parser (`TalkModeGatewayConfigParser`) that extracts configuration from a snapshot, with fallbacks and environment variables.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses configuration snapshot to produce a `TalkModeGatewayConfigState` with provided defaults and environment variables support.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides a default `TalkModeGatewayConfigState` using fallback values and environment variables.
